verdict.rationale: Bun's docs show a command surface that mirrors npm, yarn and pnpm. `bun install` is pitched as a drop-in switch from `npm install`, and the CLI has familiar commands (add, remove, update, outdated, why, info, link, publish, `bun pm pack` following `npm pack` rules) plus familiar flags (`-g/--global`, `--frozen-lockfile`, `--filter`, production mode). It also honours npm `overrides` and Yarn `resolutions` in package.json, so incumbent conventions carry over largely intact. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of command/flag parity, an explicit npm/yarn/pnpm command-mapping reference, and parity for dependency lifecycle scripts (Bun deliberately skips postinstall unless the package is listed in trustedDependencies, a notable divergence from incumbent behavior).
